title: The Strongest Magic System Has Weaknesses

voice.direction: A calm guide with a hint of relish. The hook is a quiet secret, not a trailer line. 'Meet the Unmaker' is cool and level; 'she can erase' lands softly, more chilling for it. 'But only what she can see' is the turn: slower, a small smile. 'Smoke. Fog. A wall.' are three placed pieces, a beat each. 'And she has to plan too' warns. The lesson is clear and sure, and the CTA is warm.

lines.text: The secret to a terrifying wizard isn't making them unbeatable.
Meet the Unmaker. Anything she can see, she can erase.
But only what she can see.
So the heroes stop fighting, and start thinking.
Smoke. Fog. A wall. Every shadow becomes a path.
And she has to plan too: mirrors, lanterns, a higher tower.
Unbeatable is boring. A weakness turns a fight into a puzzle.
Follow for more ways to make fictional powers interesting.

shots.purpose: Stop the scroll on the caster: a cloaked figure on a high balcony whose sight sweeps the misty castle like a searchlight, and the hook's promise that her terror isn't invincibility.
shots.visual: A cloaked woman on a high arched balcony, seen from behind, over a misty castle at dusk; a pale lilac beam (code) reaches from her hood into the mist and slowly sweeps. 'THE TERRIFYING WIZARD / isn't unbeatable.'

shots.purpose: Show the power once, on a thing: her sight lands on the courtyard gate and the gate simply stops existing. Threat by implication.
shots.visual: The great iron-strapped wooden gate at dusk; the lilac beam slants in from her tower, the gate's edge lights, and on 'erase' it dissolves cell by cell into the dark, shedding motes. Tag 'THE UNMAKER / Sees it. Erases it.'

shots.purpose: The weakness, made visible: on a top-down plan her sight is a cone, ray-cast against the cover, so every pillar and the well throw a blind spot.
shots.visual: Top-down courtyard plan on dark midnight: walls, two pillars, a well, her lilac eye on the top wall. Her sight cone opens and sweeps; black blind spots trail behind each piece of cover. 'BLIND SPOT' chips pin behind the well and in the corner beside her. Tag 'THE WEAKNESS / Line of sight'.
shots.camera: Static diagram; the cone does the moving.
shots.lighting: Midnight board; the cone carries the light.
shots.onScreenText: Tag 'THE WEAKNESS' + 'Line of sight'; 'BLIND SPOT' chips.
shots.transition: Hard cut on 'So' to the heroes.
shots.music: Ab major 7 under a held C: the first crack of hope.

shots.purpose: What the weakness does to the other side: the heroes stop charging and start planning. They wait in the column's shadow while her sight passes over.
shots.visual: Three hooded adventurers, faces unseen, wait in the shadow of a great column at night; a lilac sweep of sight passes above them across the arches. Tag 'THE HEROES / Think, don't fight'.

shots.purpose: The puzzle solved in three moves: each piece of cover they add (smoke, fog, a wall) cuts a new blind spot out of her cone, until a route through the shadows reaches her door.
shots.visual: The plan again. On 'Smoke' a smoke cloud blooms, on 'Fog' a fog bank rolls in, on 'A wall' a wall drops; each casts a new shadow in the sweeping cone. On 'Every shadow becomes a path' an amber dotted route draws from the gate through the shadows to the tower door, and three hero tokens move along it. Tag 'THE PUZZLE / Make your own shadows'.
shots.onScreenText: Tag 'THE PUZZLE' + 'Make your own shadows'; labels SMOKE / FOG / WALL; dotted route to the door.
shots.transition: Hard cut on 'And' to her terrace.

shots.purpose: The weakness cuts both ways: she plans too. A mirror bends her sight around corners, lanterns burn the fog away, and she climbs higher. She is more frightening, not less.
shots.visual: The Unmaker on a terrace at night beside a huge oval iron mirror frame; her lilac sight strikes the frame and bends away across the castle; the lantern beside her flares on 'lanterns'. Tag 'HER MOVE / She plans too'.
shots.camera: Slow push with a slight rise (1.04 to 1.08).

shots.purpose: The lesson: the solved puzzle lifts, a one-line nod to the whole arc (can, can't, costs, consequences, weakness), then the principle.
shots.visual: The plan, solved (smoke, fog, wall, the route to the door), lifts to the top. A small row: CAN · CAN'T · COSTS · CONSEQUENCES · WEAKNESS (the last in ember). Then 'UNBEATABLE IS BORING / A weakness turns a fight into a puzzle.'

shots.music: F to C major, warm; fades fully before the last frame.

lesson: A caster isn't frightening because nothing can stop them; they are frightening when the story has to work around them. Give a powerful caster one strategic weakness (line of sight, silence, preparation, a rare resource) and every encounter becomes a puzzle: the heroes must think instead of charge, and the caster must plan to cover the gap. Tension without powerlessness.
